items.defectStatement: EmbeddableHost restricts the final hostname suffix to 2–5 letters, rejecting legitimate hosts such as example.technology when administrators create or update embedding relationships.
obligations: Accept legitimate alphabetic hostname suffixes longer than five letters, including example.technology.
Preserve acceptance of previously supported valid hosts.
Retain hostname format validation rather than accepting arbitrary strings.
items.notes: Removing the suffix upper bound fixes this defect locally; a broader hostname-validator rewrite is unnecessary.
